automationNotes: Doc: App Switcher → **Personalize** → **Personalize Projects** → project card → **Attributes** → **+ New Attribute** → modal **New Attribute** (**Name**, **Key**, optional **Description**) → **Create**. Handlers / selectors: **`rules/core/actionRules.ts`** (`personalizeClickFlow`), **`personalize-nav-attributes`**, **`add-new-attribute-button`**, **`cs-modal-title-new-attribute`**, **`attribute-form-submit`**. Project card needle: **`PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** / **`DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`**, fallback **Doc Personalize Project**, else first card with `/personalize/projects/` link (see **manage-personalize-project**). Verify for **+ New Attribute** accepts UI text **New Attribute** (plus icon only) per **actionRules** special case.
